description: sdd-acceptance (optional, advisory) for demo evidence: one item per (acceptance criterion, observed demo), state = {criterion: {text}, observed: {command, output}} where criterion.text is the GIVEN/WHEN/THEN line and observed is the command the human watched and its captured output. It helps the human decide before `sdd accept record demo --pass true|false`; the human's answer is what gets recorded, and Jev never records, waives, signs off, stops the loop or runs in CI. Score levels are 0 not shown, 1 partial, 2 shown: below `flag_below`, tell the human which part of the THEN the output does not seem to show; at or above it, still ask the human to confirm.

shows_then.instructions: The command `observed.command` was run for the acceptance criterion `criterion.text` and printed `observed.output`. How completely does that output show the outcome required by the THEN part of the criterion?
criteria: The output does not show the required outcome: it is missing, contradicts it, shows an error, or is about something else
The output shows part of the required outcome, or shows it only indirectly, so a reader cannot confirm the whole THEN from it
The output plainly shows the whole outcome the THEN part requires
